reference_policy.reference_01: Bold rounded silhouettes, expressive faces, saturated accents, restrained dimensional highlights.
reference_policy.reference_02: Hand-painted gouache, cut-paper layering, organic contours, soft visible grain.
reference_policy.merge_rule: Use reference 01 for shape clarity and reference 02 for surface texture; keep one shared palette and lighting system.
reference_policy.originality_rule: Invent new characters. Do not reuse the reference owl, knight, costumes, logos, or signature silhouettes.

visual_layers.interface: Clean white surfaces, generous spacing, crisp readable text.
visual_layers.illustration: Original mascot, navigation art, category covers, demonstration hands, optional stickers.
visual_layers.learning_objects: Verified real photographs for real-world recognition; never stylize these photographs.
visual_layers.factual_symbols: Accurate editable letters, numerals, shapes, maps, and flags; preserve their actual forms and colors.

palette.usage: Use at most three strong accent colors per composition. Accent colors do not automatically qualify as accessible text backgrounds.

shape_language.silhouettes: Large, soft, rounded, readable at small sizes.
shape_language.edges: Slight organic irregularity; no heavy black outline.
shape_language.detail_density: Low; remove details unrelated to the action.
shape_language.depth: Two or three tonal planes with one soft highlight.
shape_language.texture: Fine gouache grain inside illustration shapes only; never over text or learning photographs.

proposed_mascot.description: An original teal pebble-shaped garden helper with small leaf-shaped arms, two short feet, navy oval eyes, and subtle coral cheeks.
proposed_mascot.body_proportions: Rounded body approximately 1.15 times taller than wide; lock proportions after the first approved character sheet.
proposed_mascot.consistency_reference: Require a saved, approved turnaround and expression sheet before large-batch asset generation.

composition.background: Transparent for standalone assets; white for presentation scenes.
composition.subject_scale: Large enough to remain legible at 96 CSS pixels.
composition.scene_rule: One focal action, no crowd, no decorative clutter.
composition.text_rule: No baked-in lettering. Render all interface text as editable HTML or SVG text.

typography.headings: A licensed rounded sans-serif, such as Nunito Sans.
typography.instructions: A highly legible licensed sans-serif, such as Atkinson Hyperlegible.
typography.literacy_rule: Review teaching glyphs and phonics conventions with an early-years educator; do not use decorative letterforms.
typography.arabic: Use a verified Arabic-supporting font and proper right-to-left layout; do not generate Arabic lettering as illustration.

motion.style: Small, purposeful squash-and-stretch and soft easing.
motion.reduced_motion: Use a static state change instead of nonessential motion.

export.vector: Actual SVG paths for simple icons and genuinely vector artwork.
export.textured_art: Transparent PNG or WebP; do not disguise a bitmap as editable vector art.

quality_gate: Compare palette, silhouette, proportions, face, lighting, grain, and pose with the approved reference sheet.
Reject accidental resemblance to the reference characters.
Reject extra limbs, malformed hands, illegible details, or stray text.
Keep exact educational symbols and real photographs outside mascot stylization.
Record actual review status; a JSON file alone does not certify asset consistency.
